actions.description: Investigate and resolve API auth token 401 error on payments sandbox. Determine whether issue is CRM-side config, payments API gateway config, or token scope configuration. This is blocking all payments integration testing.
actions.basis_for_owner: Sarah (TL) explicitly volunteered to look at auth token issue with Priya. As tech lead, she is responsible for unblocking critical integration issues.
actions.basis_for_deadline: This is a critical blocker preventing testing. Meeting was 29 Apr; resolving within 3 days allows testing to proceed before Priya's leave on 12 May.

actions.description: Coordinate with Sarah on auth token 401 investigation. Verify token scope configuration on payments side and provide any additional debugging information needed.
actions.basis_for_owner: Priya owns the payments sandbox environment and suspects token scope config issue on their side. She must be involved in the investigation.
actions.basis_for_deadline: Same critical blocker as A001. Must be resolved before Priya's leave 12-16 May to maintain momentum.

actions.description: Investigate and fix sandbox connection timeout issue (connection dropping after ~90 seconds of inactivity). Identify and update timeout configuration.
actions.basis_for_owner: Priya stood up the payments sandbox environment and is responsible for its operational configuration.
actions.basis_for_deadline: Secondary blocker affecting usability of sandbox. Should be resolved early in the week of 5 May, before Priya's leave on 12 May.

actions.description: Raise ticket for sandbox timeout configuration issue to track the fix and ensure it is properly documented.
actions.basis_for_owner: Priya identified the issue and owns the sandbox environment. She should create the ticket to track the work.
actions.basis_for_deadline: Should be created immediately after identification to ensure visibility and tracking. Meeting was 29 Apr.

actions.description: Clarify null field handling specification with payments API contract. Determine whether payments schema expects empty strings, omitted fields, or null values for optional fields. Document the contract requirement.
actions.basis_for_owner: Priya owns the payments integration and is responsible for understanding the payments API contract. She flagged uncertainty about the exact spec.
actions.basis_for_deadline: This blocks CRM field mapping v1 finalization and must be resolved before testing can proceed. Should be clarified before Priya's leave on 12 May.

actions.description: Update CRM field mapping v1 to implement null field handling based on payments API contract specification. Ensure CRM correctly transforms null values according to payments schema requirements.
actions.basis_for_owner: Marco completed the initial CRM field mapping v1 and raised the null handling issue. He must implement the fix.
actions.basis_for_deadline: Depends on A005 (contract clarification). Must be completed before testing phase can proceed. Target before Priya's leave ends on 16 May.

actions.description: Clarify security review sign-off ownership and status. Determine whether CISO's team owns the review or if it should be assigned to another party. Obtain current status and timeline for completion.
actions.basis_for_owner: Alan is the DM and mentioned the overdue security review sign-off. He must clarify ownership and drive resolution of this blocker.
actions.basis_for_deadline: Security review is overdue and must be completed before testing phase. This is a critical path item for the May go-live timeline.

actions.description: Obtain final environment variable names for payments integration from Priya and provide to James for deployment pipeline update.
actions.basis_for_owner: Priya owns the payments environment and must provide the final variable names. She committed to sending these to James.
actions.basis_for_deadline: James needs these before 12 May (start of Priya's leave) to update the deployment pipeline. Providing by 6 May allows time for James to implement.

actions.description: Update deployment pipeline to include new payments environment variables. Implement changes once final variable names are received from Priya.
actions.basis_for_owner: James (DevOps) is responsible for deployment pipeline configuration and flagged the need for this update.
actions.basis_for_deadline: Must be completed before go-live testing. Deadline set for 13 May to allow time after Priya provides variable names (A008) and before critical testing phase.

actions.description: Assess feasibility of end of May go-live timeline. Evaluate remaining unknowns, blockers, and dependencies. Make official decision on whether to proceed with May go-live or adjust timeline.
actions.basis_for_owner: Alan (DM) raised the end of May go-live timeline. As decision maker, he must assess feasibility and make the official call.
actions.basis_for_deadline: Sarah noted 'there's a lot of unknowns still'. Decision must be made by 9 May to allow time for planning adjustments if timeline changes. This is before Priya's leave ends on 16 May.

actions.description: Establish recurring meeting slot that accommodates both BST (UK) and SGT (Singapore) attendees. Propose alternating meeting times or find compromise time slot.
actions.basis_for_owner: Alan is the DM and was tasked with sorting out the recurring meeting slot to address timezone coordination issues.
actions.basis_for_deadline: Recurring meetings are needed to maintain momentum on the integration. Should be established early in the week of 5 May to allow scheduling of follow-up meetings.
